title: Aviation runway excursion
goal: Show aviation landing threats, barriers, and outcomes around a runway excursion.

rubric.must: The central top event visibly states runway excursion on landing.
Unstable approach, contaminated runway, excessive speed, and late touchdown are visible as separate left-side threats.
Each visible threat path contains labelled preventative barriers before the top event.
Hull damage, injury, and runway closure visibly lie beyond mitigative barriers on the right.
The landing-performance path visibly shows an out-of-date report escalation and its inspection/update barrier.
RESA, arrestor system, evacuation, and rescue response are visibly labelled mitigations.
The drawing visibly reads as a balanced bowtie with threats left and consequences right.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/bowtie/ideal.svg (sha256 4484bd18b387), source sha256 9f0d95f81486. Role-coloured threats and consequences, neutral prevention/mitigation chains, green top-event disc, hazard header, and a separately attached escalation/control chain; all declared barriers retained. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
